summary: @ornikar/lerna-config preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, chmods it executable, and then uses it via `execFileSync` to run a locally shipped ~710KB obfuscated file `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array rotation via a `WV8StW`-style decoder, opaque numeric/string constant arrays). A lerna configuration package has no legitimate reason to fetch a separate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated bundle under it; the alternate-runtime invocation also bypasses Node-based scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code paths. On `npm install`, the obfuscated payload executes with the installer's privileges, granting arbitrary code execution on the installing machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
